prompt: Prime-time adult animated sitcom characters with simple rounded cartoon bodies, flat colour and black outlines, but every face is painted with startling real skin: pores, stubble, wrinkles, wet tired eyes, real eyelids, far more lifelike than anything around it, no feature exaggerated. Every colour is laid on in thick visible oil brushstrokes. A rainy evening in a grand 1930s marble bank lobby, seen from just behind a thin young white clerk with centre-parted oiled hair and sleeve garters: his shoulder and his hand holding a pen, frozen above a blank loan form, fill the near foreground on the right. Across the desk, large and off-centre left, a heavy-set Black man in his fifties with a shaved head, a broken nose and a double chin, in a shabby brown suit two sizes too small, his hat in his hands, waiting with a tired, hopeful real-skinned face. Deep behind him, small across the hall, the huge round vault door stands open and glows warm gold from inside; three gangsters in pinstripe suits with heavy sacks over their shoulders, a fat one with a scar through his top lip, a thin bald one with big ears and a young one with slicked red hair and freckles stroll straight into it, past an old white guard in a peaked cap with brass buttons who tips his cap to them. Tall rain-streaked windows glow cold blue; green-shaded banker's lamps sit on the desks; rain tracked in across the polished marble floor in puddles and bootprints. Most of the hall in shadow; the brightest values are the vault mouth and its long streak of gold across the wet marble floor. Plain margins with no writing. Thanks.
